summary: A free, drop-in creative-practice session facilitated by Andy Collins (of Inward & Artward School of Creativity) as part of Story Parlor's recurring 'Sunday Sessions' program. The event's own listing describes it as a recurring entry in that program with an explicit 'come as you are' open-attendance invitation, no mention of membership, dues, or a stable roster of participants.

evidence.note: Listing describes a facilitator-led session to build creative courage and trust, run by Inward & Artward facilitator Andy Collins, with a supportive small-group atmosphere but no membership or joining language.
Full event page explicitly calls this 'a recurring event in our Sunday Sessions program' and invites drop-in attendance with 'Come as you are'; no dues, roster, or membership mentioned.
Story Parlor's own site frames itself as a ticketed venue offering 'Events + Shows', 'Classes + Workshops', 'Sunday Sessions' and 'Season Passes' rather than hosting independent membership groups.

Inward & Artward is a 'School of Creativity' offering classes, workshops, and facilitator training through a network of certified facilitators; Andy Collins is one such facilitator delivering a class-like offering, not leading a standing member group.

Only 2 dated instances found (Sep 27 and Oct 25, 2026), both titled identically as part of the 'Morning Sessions | Last Sundays' series, consistent with a recurring commercial program rather than a persistent community with a name of its own.
